thread:
nora: Heads-up: I hit a goroutine leak in the Go generator sample when cancelling via ctx. Repro: start generator, cancel after first chunk, pprof shows a leftover goroutine stuck in handshakeLoop reading ackCh.

ben: saw it too. repro is trivial and consistent. think handshake reader isn't observing ctx.Done().

ashwin: paste the tiny repro you used?

nora: minimal snippet from sample app:
```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
iter := client.Generator(ctx, req)
go func() { time.Sleep(50*time.Millisecond); cancel() }()
for iter.Next() { _ = iter.Token() }
fmt.Println("iter err:", iter.Err())
```
After cancel the iterator stops yielding but pprof shows goroutine in generator.go:handshakeLoop blocked on ackCh.

ben: quick fix idea: spawn a ctx watcher when creating iterator that calls an idempotent cleanup using sync.Once to close ackCh. avoids double-close races.

chris: API thought: implement io.Closer on iterator so samples can `defer iter.Close()`; low friction. But we should still make ctx cancel auto-clean.

ashwin: prefer the writer own channel close; signal writer to exit on ctx.Done() and have it close ackCh. sync.Once is fine as a guard. Also add a ForEach helper to hide Next/Err boilerplate in onboarding samples.

nora: onboarding-first: samples should work with just ctx cancellation, but include `defer iter.Close()` in examples and show ForEach for quickstarts. Docs should describe cancellation patterns and link to the issue.

dev-bot: Created issue #371: "go-sdk: generator ackCh goroutine leak on ctx cancel"  https://github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk/issues/371

ben: i'll open a draft PR implementing io.Closer + sync.Once cleanup + ForEach(ctx, fn). tests: unit to ensure ackCh closed once, integration that cancels after first token and asserts goroutine count returns to baseline.

chris: add Dedicated/private runtime audit to ensure same handshake path is covered.

ashwin: will review PR and run dedicated tests. CI note: integration should skip race detector to avoid flakiness.

nora: thanks. once PR merges i'll update the sample app and onboarding readme.

ben: PR draft will be posted here when ready.

chris: follow-ups assigned: ben -> PR, ashwin -> runtime audit, nora -> docs/sample update. :rocket:
